# Landfall — answer quality (E9.4)

Can an operator see a bad answer? Volume, latency and error rate per tool; `query_inventory` outcomes; the confidence mix of every published estimate; recent errors. All from telemetry the deployment already emits (`requests` per function invocation, `traces` from `obs.event`).

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize calls=count(), failed=countif(success==false), p50_ms=round(percentile(duration,50)), p95_ms=round(percentile(duration,95)) by tool=operation_Name
| order by calls desc
content.title: Tool calls — last 24h (volume, failures, latency)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize failRate=round(100.0*countif(success==false)/count(),1), calls=count()
| extend status = iff(failRate > 5.0, 'ELEVATED', 'ok')
content.title: Function failure rate (24h) — alert fires above 5%

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where customDimensions.event == 'query_inventory'
| summarize count() by status=tostring(customDimensions.status)
| order by count_ desc
content.title: query_inventory outcomes (ok / rejected / text_to_sql_error / query_error)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where customDimensions.event == 'estimate_assembled'
| project timestamp, engagement=tostring(customDimensions.engagement), status=tostring(customDimensions.status), overall=tostring(customDimensions.overall_confidence), low=toint(customDimensions.low), medium=toint(customDimensions.medium), high=toint(customDimensions.high), figures=toint(customDimensions.figures)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Estimates assembled / published — confidence mix (7d)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where severityLevel >= 3
| project timestamp, tool=operation_Name, message
| order by timestamp desc
| take 50
content.title: Errors — last 24h (severity >= Error)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where success == false
| summarize failures=count() by tool=operation_Name, resultCode
| order by failures desc
content.title: Failures by tool + result code (24h)
